_note: Expected-red cases of the release chain's integration branch chain-v030 (advisor, #299). A chain suite listed here passes its CI step only when its red cases equal these entries exactly (bin/chain-known-red.py judge). An entry is removed in the PR that turns its case green; an added entry must be named in the PR body by a line `known-red-add: <id>`. The cutover pull request needs every entry but KR-CUTOVER gone (`chain-known-red.py empty-except KR-CUTOVER`); the pull request that commits the rc-proof marker needs the list empty (`empty`).
